protocol.receiver: What is the opposite of "small"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.
protocol.donor: What is the opposite of "hot"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.
protocol.attention_patterns: unfrozen, normal recomputation at all layers
protocol.mlp_outputs: original MLPs recompute; add fixed clean-reference decoder contribution deltas only at layer22 token9
protocol.weights: never edited; no full transcoder replacement
protocol.selection: Labels and natural donor/receiver activation only; no P(cold)-based feature selection before the exploratory sweep. Eligible small: clean activation > donor and >0. Eligible hot: donor activation > clean and >0. Top 6 each ranked by activation difference; include published source IDs among pair sources. Also top-k groups for k=1,3,6,all. This is exploratory on the primary prompt.
protocol.coupled_rule: delta = strength * sum over selected features((donor_activation-clean_activation)*fixed_decoder). For small features with zero donor: effective (1-strength)*clean. For hot features with zero clean: strength*donor.
protocol.zero_small_rule: subtract clean small contributions once, independently sweep donor-minus-clean hot contribution strengths
controls: best condition repeated with observed attention patterns
heldout_prompts: Give the antonym of "small". Answer with one word.
One word only: what is the opposite of small?
What word means the opposite of small? Answer with a single word.
Return only the antonym of the adjective "small".
protocol.limits: Finite strength search, not every real-valued strength. Single primary prompt probability is not an accuracy rate. Labels incomplete and contextual. Single layer does not imply a single feature.
